maximize: The $75 commission cap makes TCGplayer the cheapest platform for premium cards — a $2,000 slab costs $75 commission here vs. ~$150+ elsewhere. List low-value singles in bulk lots instead: the $0.30 fixed transaction fee kills margins on sub-$3 cards, so bundle dollar-bin cards into playsets or lots. Use TCGplayer Direct for hands-off fulfillment if your volume justifies the per-item fees; otherwise ship standard marketplace orders yourself with exact postage costs. Grade conservatively — condition disputes are the #1 margin killer on card marketplaces. With sports cards newly opened to the marketplace, early movers get first-mover pricing visibility.
